description: The plot illustrates the relationship between "o_pop frequency" and "Accuracy" for two different accuracy metrics: "Initial Accuracy" and "Final Accuracy". The x-axis represents "o_pop frequency (x10^4)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 19, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents "Accuracy" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The "Initial Accuracy" line is depicted in green with a solid line style, square markers, and error bars, starting at approximately 0.35 at an "o_pop frequency" of 1, peaking at around 0.5 at a frequency of 5, and then decreasing to about 0.25 at a frequency of 9 before rising to 0.5 at a frequency of 13 and then declining again to around 0.3 at a frequency of 19. The "Final Accuracy" line is shown in blue with a dashed line style, circular markers, and error bars, beginning at approximately 0.7 at an "o_pop frequency" of 1, generally remaining above 0.7 across the x-axis range, with values ranging from about 0.65 to 0.9, and exhibiting fluctuations, with a peak of around 0.9 at a frequency of 9 and a dip to approximately 0.65 at a frequency of 15.
